name: Series 1 Bond-Type Class Shares of INFRONEER Holdings Inc.
summary: INFRONEER Holdings Inc. and its subsidiaries provide infrastructure services in Japan through Building Construction, Civil Engineering and Paving segments. They carry out construction for multi-dwelling complexes, factories, logistics centers, bridges and tunnels, make and sell asphalt mixture, and take on concession projects such as acquiring operating rights for public infrastructure. The company dates from 2021 and has its head office in Tokyo, Japan.
